class.name: mujoco_ros2_control_examples/UnitreeHgLowLevel
class.description: Serves the Unitree G1/H1-2 low-level interface from inside the simulation: subscribes to unitree_hg/LowCmd, publishes unitree_hg/LowState, and closes the per-motor PD loop into mjData::qfrc_applied on every physics step. Built only when the unitree_hg messages are in the workspace, so it lives in its own library rather than beside the other example plugins.
